biotools.summary: AutoEpiCollect is a GUI software utilizing machine learning to generate safe and immunogenic epitopes from missense mutations in oncogenes, streamlining preclinical vaccine design. The software incorporates a probabilistic logistic regression model trained on experimental T-cell assay data and has been applied to design a pan-cancer vaccine targeting PIK3CA mutations.
